glossary.OWD: Organization-Wide Defaults: baseline record access for each object.
glossary.PSG: Permission Set Group: bundle of permission sets assigned as one persona.
glossary.LWC: Lightning Web Component: standards-based UI component of the Lightning platform.
glossary.Named Credential: Secure definition of a callout endpoint and its authentication.
glossary.External Credential: Authentication definition (protocol, principals) used by named credentials.
glossary.Custom Metadata: Deployable configuration records, read by code and flows without consuming queries.
glossary.Flow: Declarative automation of the Salesforce platform (record-triggered, scheduled, screen, autolaunched).
glossary.Queue: Shared owner for records awaiting assignment.
glossary.Record Type: Variant of an object with its own business process, picklist values and page layout.
